title: What are the benefits of using a gas stove?
desc: Gas stoves offer instant heat control, cost-effectiveness with natural gas, and consistent heat for even cooking.

title: How do I clean a gas stove?
desc: Regular cleaning involves wiping the surface with a damp cloth and mild detergent. For tougher stains, use a specialised stove cleaner and scrub the grates and burners.

title: How often should I check my gas stove for leaks?
desc: It’s advisable to check for leaks annually or whenever you smell gas near the stove.

title: What should I do if I smell gas?
desc: Do not light any matches or turn on any electrical switches. Open windows to ventilate, turn off the gas supply if possible, and call a professional.

title: What’s the difference between a conventional and a convection gas stove?
desc: Convection stoves have fans that circulate hot air, cooking food more evenly and quickly than conventional stoves.

title: How do I convert my gas stove from natural gas to propane?
desc: You need a conversion kit, and to ensure safety, a qualified technician should perform the conversion.

title: Can I install a gas stove myself?
desc: It’s recommended to have your gas stove installed by an expert professional to ensure it meets safety standards.

title: Do gas stoves provide better temperature control than electric stoves?
desc: Yes, gas stoves allow for precise and immediate temperature adjustments while cooking.

title: What is the best way to clean the burners on a gas stove?
desc: Remove the burners, soak them in warm water and detergent, then scrub with a non-abrasive brush.

title: What types of gas stoves are available on the market?
desc: Options include freestanding ranges, slide-in ranges, and built-in cooktops.

title: How can I improve the efficiency of my gas stove?
desc: Regularly clean burners and use the correct size pots with lids to conserve heat.

title: Can I cook on a gas stove during a gas leak?
desc: No, cooking or even turning on the stove is extremely dangerous if you suspect a gas leak.
